import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Constants
ARRAY_SIZE = 10000

def task_func():
    array = np.random.randint(1, 101, size=ARRAY_SIZE)
    mean = np.mean(array)
    std = np.std(array)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    bins = np.arange(0.5, 101.5, 1)
    ax.hist(array, bins=bins, edgecolor="black", alpha=0.7)

    ax.axvline(mean, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Mean")
    ax.axvline(mean - std, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Standard Deviation")
    ax.axvline(mean + std, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2)

    ax.set_title("Histogram of Random Integers")
    ax.set_xlabel("Value")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.legend()

    return array, mean, std, ax
